concept_definition: Coming before all others in order; number one in a sequence.
An ordinal adjective meaning 'coming after the first in a series; number two in order'. Used to indicate position (e.g., the second item).
The ordinal indicating position number three in an ordered sequence (after second and before fourth). Used to describe the item that comes in position three.
Denoting the position number four in an ordered sequence; the ordinal corresponding to the number four.
The ordinal number equal to five; used to indicate something in position number five in an ordered sequence.
Being number six in a series or order; the position after fifth and before seventh.
The ordinal indicating position number seven in a sequence; coming after the sixth.
An ordinal number meaning 'number eight in a sequence' or 'in the eighth position'. (Used to indicate order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, ... 8th.)
An ordinal adjective meaning in position number nine in a sequence (one after eighth and before tenth).
The ordinal form of the number ten; indicates the position number ten in an ordered sequence (e.g., the tenth item).
coming after all others in time or order
